intervention_contract.intervention: After a learned, parseable, exactly verified two-unit provisional artifact, replace only the selected unit replacement block with a declared sentinel failure while preserving the artifact envelope and all identity fields.
intervention_contract.feedback: Apply the intervened artifact to the original source, run the independent exact validator, map its observed marker to an obligation, and close that obligation over its preregistered dependency ancestors.
intervention_contract.repair: Give the model the original request, intervened artifact, authentic validator packet, implicated closure, and an instruction to copy the unrelated unit byte-for-byte.
intervention_contract.rotation: Case 1 intervenes on U1 and measures U2 preservation; case 2 intervenes on U2 and measures U1 preservation.

decision_rule.pass: The static ladder rejects all five corruptions; both learned provisional artifacts parse, lower, and exactly verify; both controlled interventions produce their preregistered validator marker and dependency closure; both learned repairs parse, lower, and exactly verify; each targeted unit changes; each unrelated unit is byte-stable; the independent locality audit is clean; one persistent model load serves exactly four calls; every call ends by parser completion or model EOS; and no physical-context boundary is hit.
decision_rule.failure: INCONCLUSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION; retain every receipt and stop before fresh P4 task acquisition.
decision_rule.pass_authority: Closes only the non-claim Semantic-IR mechanics prerequisite and permits freezing a fresh source-disjoint P4 decision denominator. No cognitive-compilation, D1, training, serving, or book-support authority is granted.
